content.short: Guardarian is a fully licensed, EU-based non-custodial fiat on/off-ramp platform enabling instant crypto exchanges for individuals and businesses.
content.description: Guardarian is a fully licensed, EU-based non-custodial fiat on/off-ramp platform designed to simplify crypto payments. Launched in 2017, it powers a wide range of Web3 projects by providing access to buying and selling 400+ cryptocurrencies. The solution features simple API integrations, guided onboarding, and round-the-clock customer support, helping teams and users move funds quickly and securely. This combination gives clients a reliable, scalable way to offer fast fiat-to-crypto and crypto-to-fiat transactions.
